title: Publish an explicit portable copy manifest
summary: Compare the full package with the planner's allowlist. Define which starter, schema, documentation, and license files belong to the supported installation and upgrade paths.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Human and agent installs can use a shared expected file set.
risks: Treating a planner listing as the complete package can omit the README and license.

evidence.claim: The planner selects an allowlist and omits the package README and LICENSE.
